Extract of Proceedings in S. S. D. Court for 10/8/35 F. I. R. No. 002 10/35 Stn. No.
Reg. No. 9/4394 Stn. (K.P.O.L R.) Procurator S.K.77 Judge

Application for disposal/
Application is hereby made to the S.S.D.Court for the
disposal of the attached list of properties found in a 1st
floor front room of premises 33 Tsing Wei Rd off Yuting Rd,
following the arrest of the two occupants by Officers attached
to the Public Safety Bureau, Headquarters, Nanto at 8 a.m. 10/8/
1935.

Property found at premises No 33 Tsing Wei Rd, off Yuting Rd.

1. 4 cotton quilts.
2. 8 cotton bedcovers,
3. 5 bed sheets.
4. 1 woolen blanket,
5. 3 cotton padded jackets,
6. 4 pillows.
7. 1 iron bed stand.
8. 2 wooden trays.
9. 1 table.
10. 1 cupboard.
11. 3 leather trunks.
12. 4 square benches.
13. 1 long bench.
14. 1 brass basin.
15. 1 net basket.
16. 1 cotton long gown.
17. 1 overcoat.
18. 1 fur blanket.
19. 7 jackets.
20. 2 long gowns.
21. 1 mosquito net,
22. 2 lined long gowns.
23. 1 fur lined jacket.
24. 3 pies of cloth material.

DISTRICT COURT NO.2 (A.B.)

Proceedings Mr.Chang appeared for the S.M.Council.

Mr.Chang:-At 8am, the 11/8/35, three men one armed with a pistol
entered 33 Tsing Wei Rd, Yuting Rd, and arrested a man and his wife,
and took them to the P.S.Bureau. Later the police got to hear of
this, and when they made inquiries at the P.S.Bureau, found that the
arrested persons had been handed over to the Chinkiang Authorities,
and stated that the arrested persons were arrested in a house in
Chapail. The Chief tenant of the house, states that these persons
were arrested in her house, which is in the Settlement, and the Settle-
ment Police and the P.S.Bureau are still in negotiations over this
question. In the house there was a lot of property as on the
charge sheet left there, so I ask the Court to dispose of same. I
suggest that this be auctioned and the money sent to Court pending
claimant. The arrested persons are man and wife and are small
farmers.

Mr.Tung:-In addition the said arrest Hwang and his wife rented the
premises some time hence for the past three months. They were
arrested by three men one armed with a pistol on Sunday morning
by Chinkiang S.I in the Settlement.

1935年8月10日第二特区地方法院诉讼记录摘录 F.I.R.编号 002 10/35 警署编号

处置申请/
现向第二特区地方法院提出申请，要求处置附单所列之财产。该等财产发现于毓亭路（Yuting Rd）外青威路（Tsing Wei Rd）33号 premises 的前楼房间。两名居住者于1935年8月10日上午8时被隶属于南市总部公共安全局的警官逮捕。

发现于毓亭路外青威路33号 premises 的财产清单：

1. 棉被4条。
2. 棉被套8条。
3. 床单5条。
4. 羊毛毯1条。
5. 棉袄3件。
6. 枕头4个。
7. 铁床架1副。
8. 木托盘2个。
9. 桌子1张。
10. 橱柜1个。
11. 皮箱3只。
12. 方凳4条。
13. 长凳1条。
14. 铜盆1只。
15. 网篮1只。
16. 棉长衫1件。
17. 大衣1件。
18. 皮毯1条。
19. 夹克7件。
20. 长衫2件。
21. 蚊帐1顶。
22. 夹长衫2件。
23. 皮里夹克1件。
24. 布料3匹。

第二特区地方法院 (A.B.)

诉讼记录 张先生代表工部局出席。

张先生：- 1935年8月11日上午8时，三名男子，其中一人持手枪，进入毓亭路青威路33号，逮捕了一名男子及其妻子，并将他们带往公共安全局。随后警方获悉此事，当向公共安全局查询时，发现被捕者已被移交给镇江当局，并称被捕者是在闸北的一所房屋内被捕的。该房屋的二房东声称，这些人是在她位于租界内的房屋中被捕的，目前租界巡捕房与公共安全局正就此问题进行交涉。屋内留有大量财产，如起诉单所述，故我请求法庭予以处置。我建议将此等物品拍卖，所得款项暂存法庭以待认领人。被捕者为一对夫妇，系小农。

董先生：- 此外，上述被捕者黄某及其妻子租用该 premises 已有三个月左右。他们于周日早晨在租界内被三名男子（其中一人持手枪）逮捕，执行者为镇江便衣侦探。

Police to locate the relations of the owner to claim the property

station with a view to obtaining

3.

Further to Miss. Report O.O.I. 18/35.

As reported on page 4 of the 2nd report forwarded
in connection with this case, the property of the two
persons arrested at 33 Tsing Wei Li off Wuting Road, (by
Public Safety Bureau Officials) was made the subject of
an application for disposal in the S.S.D. Court a.m.
13/8/35, when after all the evidence had been heard by
Judge Wu, the following order was made:-

"Police to locate the Relations of the owner
to claim the property failing which the property
is to be kept at the station, for the time being."
Should it be inconvenient, it should be auctioned
and the proceeds sent to Court for claimant".

Since forwarding the last report in connection with
this case, intimation has been received to the effect that
an application for the described property will be made
by the Public Safety Bureau, to the S.S.D. Court, for the
said property to be handed over to them.

If and when this application is made a further
report will be forwarded.

D.S. Supt.

3.

继 O.O.I. 18/35 号报告之后。

正如在此案提交的第二份报告第4页所报告的那样，在武定路（Wuting Road）外青威里（Tsing Wei Li）33号被（公共安全局官员）逮捕的两人的财产，已于1935年8月13日上午在第二特区地方法院提出处置申请。吴法官听取所有证据后，作出如下命令：-

“警方需查找物主亲属以认领财产，若找不到，则财产暂时存放在警署。”若存放不便，应予以拍卖，所得款项送交法庭以待认领人”。

自提交关于此案的上一份报告以来，已收到通知，称公共安全局将向第二特区地方法院提出申请，要求将所述财产移交给他们。

一旦提出此申请，将另行提交报告。

副督察长

At 10a.m. 12/8/35, the undersigned and D.S.I.
TAN HAN POO, proceeded to the Public Safety Bureau, Head-
quarters, Nantao in an endeavour to seek some information
or explanation, covering the suspected arrest of one male
Chinese named "Jing" together with his wife, at about
4a.m. on 10/8/35, at 33 Tsing Wei Li off Wuting Road, as
referred to in the original report, No.19/35.
    Upon arrival at the above Bureau, one named "Yang
Hyoh Yah", Detective Inspector, attached to the Bureau, was
interviewed, who stated that the male and female, referred
to as "Jing" were arrested by himself together with other
detectives, not in the Settlement, but in a teashop situated
at 303 Kya Ka Road, Nantao, at 4a.m. on 10/8/35, these
people being implicated with being concerned together with
a notorious bandit leader named "Van Siau Err To" (范小猴子)
wanted in Chinkiang for various serious offences. Pressed
for further information, Detective Inspector, "Yang Hyoh
Yah" (楊玉福) stated that all these prisoners had been
transferred to the jurisdiction of the Chinkiang Authorities
having left Shanghai for Chinkiang at 6a.m. 12/8/35, it was
therefore, impossible for the undersigned to interview them.
    The chief-tenant of House 33, Tsing Wei Li off
Wuting Road, named "Tang Su Er" (        ) was also

继杂项报告 O.O.L. No.19/35 之后。
1935年8月12日上午10时，本人与副督察谭汉普（TAN HAN POO）前往南市总部公共安全局，试图寻求有关信息或解释，涉及原报告 No.19/35 中提及的，一名名为“Jing”的中国男子及其妻子于1935年8月10日凌晨4时许在武定路（Wuting Road）外青威里33号涉嫌被捕一事。
    到达上述局后，会见了该局所属侦探督察杨玉福（Yang Hyoh Yah，音译），他陈述称，上述被称为“Jing”的一男一女并非在租界内，而是于1935年8月10日凌晨4时在南市迦嘎路（Kya Ka Road）303号的一家茶馆内，由他与其他侦探共同逮捕。这些人涉嫌与一名名为“范小猴子”（Van Siau Err To）的臭名昭著的匪首有关联，该匪首因在镇江犯下多项重罪而被通缉。经进一步追问，侦探督察杨玉福（楊玉福）称，所有这些囚犯已被移交给镇江当局管辖，并于1935年8月12日上午6时离开上海前往镇江，因此本人无法对他们进行讯问。
    武定路外青威里33号的二房东，名为“唐苏尔”（Tang Su Er，音译）（        ）也

2 (2)

together with the undersigned to the Public Safety Bureau,
the object in view being to affect a positive identifica-
tion of the man "Jing" and his wife, but in view of the
fact that the undersigned was informed as to the transfer
of these persons to Chinkiang, this was found impossible.
Whilst present in the above Bureau, the chief-tenant
"Tsung Ts Sa" was questioned by the undersigned regarding
the clothing worn by the man "Jing" and his wife, when
taken away from her premises, at 6a.m. on 10/8/35.
The descriptions thus obtained were found to coincide
with the descriptions afforded by Det. Inspt. Yang Hyeh
Foh, who agreed that they were the persons referred to,
but denied that they were arrested at 33 Wuting Road.
A statement from the chief-tenant is attached wherein it
is stated clearly that three male Chinese, one of whom
was armed, entered her premises at 33 Wuting Road and took
"Jing" and his wife away.
At about 8.30a.m. on 11/8/35, a story describing part
of the above events, was found printed on Page 8 of "The
Eastern Times" dated 11/8/35, original with translation
attached, wherein it is stated that a big reward is offered
by the Chinkiang Authorities for the arrest and conviction
of "Tang'Sien Hsr 35", and his accomplices. The address on
Wuting Road is also mentioned, showing that this place was
known to the Public Safety Bureau Detectives.

O.O.L. 19/35.

2 (2)

与本人一同前往公共安全局，目的是对男子“Jing”及其妻子进行确切辨认，但鉴于被告知这些人已被转移至镇江，此举被发现无法实现。在上述局期间，本人就1935年8月10日上午6时男子“Jing”及其妻子被从其 premises 带走时所穿衣物询问了二房东“宗萨”（Tsung Ts Sa，音译）。由此获得的描述与侦探督察杨玉福（Yang Hyeh Foh，音译）提供的描述相符，后者同意这些就是所指之人，但否认他们是在武定路33号被捕的。附有一份二房东的陈述，其中明确指出，三名中国男子，其中一人持有武器，进入她在武定路33号的 premises，并将“Jing”及其妻子带走。
1935年8月11日上午8时30分左右，在1935年8月11日的《时事新报》（The Eastern Times）第8页上发现了一篇描述上述部分事件的报道，原文及译文附后，其中称镇江当局为逮捕并定罪“唐先赫35”（Tang'Sien Hsr 35，音译）及其同伙提供巨额赏金。报道中也提到了武定路的地址，表明公共安全局侦探知晓此地。

O.O.L. 19/35.

2 (3)

There appears to be no doubt whatever, that Det.
Inspt. "Yang Hyeh Poh" was instrumental in affecting the
arrests of the two persons in question at 33 Futing Road,
but the identities of the three persons who posed as
detectives and made the arrests cannot be ascertained..

It would appear from the trend of this enquiry that
following the illegal arrests at 33 Futing Road, the two
prisoners were conveyed to the teashop at 203 Kya Ha Road,
Nantao, from where they were later at 8a.m. officially
arrested. As it appears impossible for the Chinese
Authorities to have passed the prisoners through their
Court prior to 6p.m. 12/8/35, and as enquiries show that
no train left for Chinkiang at 6a.m. 12/8/35, it would
appear that Det. Inspt. "Yang Hyeh Poh" was merely
obstructing the enquiry, in an effort to prevent the
undersigned from obtaining conclusive evidence of their
illegal functioning in the International Settlement.

It was suggested to Det. Inspt. "Yang Hyeh Poh" that
the property and personal effects of the two prisoners,
which was left in their room at 33 Futing Road, (list of
same attached) following their arrest, he made the subject
of an application through the Court, for same to be handed
over to them. It is considered that should this be done
it would constitute conclusive proof that illegal function-
ing had taken place, in view of the fact that the Public
pages.zh:

毫无疑问，侦探督察“杨海波”（Yang Hyeh Poh，音译）促成了在弗廷路（Futing Road，原文如此，应为武定路 Wuting Road 或青威路 Tsing Wei Rd 之误）33号对上述两人的逮捕，但那三名冒充侦探并实施逮捕的人员身份无法查明。

从本次调查的趋势来看，在弗廷路（Futing Road，原文如此）33号发生非法逮捕后，两名囚犯被带至南市迦哈路（Kya Ha Road，音译，应为迦嘎路 Kya Ka Road 之误）203号的茶馆，随后于上午8时被正式逮捕。由于中国当局不可能在1935年8月12日下午6时之前通过其法院移交囚犯，且调查显示1935年8月12日上午6时没有开往镇江的火车，看来侦探督察“杨海波”（Yang Hyeh Poh，音译）只是在阻碍调查，企图阻止本人获得其在国际租界内非法行事的确凿证据。

有人向侦探督察“杨海波”建议，就两名囚犯被捕后留在弗廷路（Futing Road，原文如此）33号房间内的财产和个人物品（清单附后），通过法院提出申请，要求将其移交给他们。认为如果这样做，将构成非法行事已发生的确凿证明，鉴于公共

The property referred to above has been made the

FORM 60
G 28M.1.35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
The following is the statement of.. Toung Ta Sz (陳朱氏)
native of.. taken by me D.S. Taylor.
at Gordon Road on the 12/8/35. and interpreted by.. Clark Fan.

My name is Toung Ta Sz, F/Female, residing at No. 33,
Lane 587 off Wuting Road, and I am the chief-tenant of the
above premises.

At about 6a.m. on Saturday, 10/8/35, I was suddenly
awakened by the noise of voices. A male Chinese entered and
stated that he wanted to rent a 1st floor room. I took this
man upstairs, to a back room which is empty, thinking to rent
the room to him, when suddenly two other male Chinese dressed in
(1) A raincoat, blue colour, and (2) white long gown, appeared
behind me, the man dressed in a blue raincoat was carrying a
pistol in his hand. They then proceeded to the bedroom occupied
by one male and one female Chinese known to me as "Jing", and
after speaking for a few moments, I could not understand the
dialect much, but heard the word, "Chinkiang" spoken, they then
took the man and woman away with them. As they left the house
one of the men said that they were going to the Police Station,
but did not say where.

At about 2.30p.m. same date, detectives from Gordon Road
Station came to my house, together with two detectives from
Chinese Territory, it was then that I told the detectives about
the male and female being arrested at 6a.m. the same date.

At 10a.m. on 12/8/35, I was taken by Gordon Road Detectives
to the Public Safety Bureau, at Nanking Headquarters, where I
was told by one named "Tang Tuh Hsi", a detective, that the two
persons who rented my room, have been sent to Chinkiang at
6a.m. on Monday, 12/8/35, by train. This is my true statement.

Signed by Toung Ta Sz.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警察调查报告。
以下是.. 陈朱氏（Toung Ta Sz）.. 的陈述，籍贯.. 由本人 D.S. Taylor 于1935年8月12日在戈登路录取，并由.. Clark Fan 翻译。

我叫陈朱氏（Toung Ta Sz），女，居住在武定路（Wuting Road）外587弄33号，我是上述 premises 的二房东。

1935年8月10日，星期六，上午6时左右，我突然被说话声吵醒。一名中国男子进入，称想租一间前楼房间。我将此人带上楼，带到一间空置的后房，心想把房间租给他，这时突然另外两名中国男子出现在我身后，分别穿着 (1) 蓝色雨衣，和 (2) 白色长衫，穿蓝色雨衣的男子手中拿着一把手枪。他们随后进入由我认识的一名中国男子和一名中国女子“Jing”占用的卧室，交谈了片刻，我不太懂他们的方言，但听到了“镇江”一词，随后他们将该男女带走。当他们离开房子时，其中一人说他们要去警察局，但未说明地点。

同日午后2时30分左右，戈登路警署的侦探来到我家，同行的还有两名来自中国地界的侦探，那时我才告诉侦探们，该男女于同日早上6时被捕。

1935年8月12日上午10时，我被戈登路侦探带至南京总部公共安全局，一名名为“唐杜希”（Tang Tuh Hsi，音译）的侦探告诉我，租用我房间的那两人已于1935年8月12日，星期一，上午6时乘火车送往镇江。这是我的真实陈述。

陈朱氏签名。

"Case of arrest from the Eastern River", dated 11/8/33.
Siao Err Tu (Small number) arrested, harboring in Shanghai
for the past 6 years.
The notorious bandit leader, named Van Hyien Ts, aged 51, alias
Van Siao Err Tu, who has several thousand bandits under his control,
raping, arson and robbery in Kiangsu, more than 10 Hsien, for the
past 10 years.
The City Public Safety Bureau arrested his accomplices named Van
Zung Tuen (his 3rd uncle), Van Yue Ts (his 2nd uncle) and several
gangsters, who were escorted to the Chinkiang Police Garrison for
trial. Van Hyien Ts and his eldest son named Van Bee Dong were then
implicated by them as the leaders, so the Garrison is offering a
big reward and circular orders for their arrest were issued.
Van Hyien Ts has been living for the past 6 years in Shanghai, an
attempt had been made by the No.9 Bandit Suppression Directing
Officials in Shanghai, to arrest him, but without result.
Afterwards the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, Chief Detective Inspt.
named "Tyi Yuan Foo" received information to the effect that the
wanted man, the leader "Yan" is residing now at premises No. 35
Chang Wei Li off Nanking Road, and frequenting Nantao and Small South
Gate, etc. where teahouses are situated. The above P.S.B. appointed
Branch Detective Inspt. Sung Huang Yoo and Detective Sub-Inspt.
Sung Poh Sung, Tang Yah Jah and Lee Yun Sing together with the
Jing An Rd Police Station, No.7 Police-constable, named Wong Hyi
Hoh, have arrested the leader "Yan" at premises 353, Tih Hwang
Teahouse, Tze St. Road, Nantao, at 12 noon yesterday. (10/8/33.)
After being arrested, he gave his name as "Van Hyien Ts", aged 51,
native of Wanchiang, who came to Shanghai with several accomplices
families, residing at premises 35 Chang Wei Li off Nanking Road, and
committed all the crimes of rape, arson, robbery, etc. The Public Safety Bureau
transferred him to the jurisdictional authorities of Kiangsu and No. 9 Bandit
Suppression Directing Officials for trial.

“来自东部河流地区的逮捕案”，日期为1933年8月11日。
肖二秃（Small number）被捕，过去6年一直藏匿于上海。
这名臭名昭著的匪首名为范贤兹（Van Hyien Ts），51岁，别名范小二秃（Van Siao Err Tu），其手下控制着数千名匪徒，在过去10年间于江苏十多个县实施强奸、纵火和抢劫。
市公安局逮捕了他的同伙范宗团（Van Zung Tuen，其三叔）、范月兹（Van Yue Ts，其二叔）及数名歹徒，并将他们押送至镇江警察卫戍区受审。随后，这些人供出范贤兹及其长子范必东（Van Bee Dong）为首领，因此卫戍区发出高额悬赏，并发布了通缉令。
范贤兹过去6年一直居住在上海，上海第九剿匪督办曾试图逮捕他，但未果。
此后，上海市公安局首席侦探督察“季元福”（Tyi Yuan Foo，音译）收到情报，称被通缉的首领“严”（Yan）现居住在南京路旁昌伟里35号，并频繁出入南市和小南门等地的茶馆。上述市公安局指派分署侦探督察宋黄友（Sung Huang Yoo，音译）以及侦探副督察宋波松（Sung Poh Sung，音译）、唐亚查（Tang Yah Jah，音译）和李云星（Lee Yun Sing，音译），会同静安路警察局第7号警员王希和（Wong Hyi Hoh，音译），于昨日中午12时在南市子石路（Tze St. Road，音译）地皇茶馆353号逮捕了首领“严”。（1933年8月10日。）
被捕后，他自称名为“范贤兹”（Van Hyien Ts），51岁，万江（Wanchiang，音译）人，携数名同伙家属来到上海，居住在南京路旁昌伟里35号，犯下了强奸、纵火、抢劫等所有罪行。市公安局已将其移交给江苏管辖当局及第九剿匪督办进行审判。

1.

协助南市公共安全局。

1935年8月10日下午约2时20分，隶属于南市公共安全局总部的华籍侦探督察森根生（Seo Kung Zung）和华籍侦探警佐任桃（Zung Dau）来到本警局，请求协助前往武定路旁青伟里33号，目的是搜查一楼前间，因怀疑那里藏有武器。
上述侦探解释说，1935年8月10日上午约10时，他们在闸北赵家浜逮捕了一名名为“范小猴子”（Van Siau Err Te）的人，此人因数月之前涉及镇江的一起绑架案而被通缉，且他声称住在上述地址。因此，他们希望在该地点进行调查。

由签署人及华籍侦探警长（C.D.C.）242号提供了必要协助，并前往上述地点，发现房间已被翻乱，箱子和衣物寝具散落各处，但现场无人。

随后，二房东陈米氏（Zung Te Se，女性）告知签署人，同日（1935年8月10日）上午约8时，3名自称是侦探的华籍男子进入她的住所，直接前往一楼前间，在逮捕了住客“盛”（Sing，全名不详）及其妻子后，对他们进行了搜查

pages.en:
O.O.L.19/35.

1 (2)

and took them away, one of the male Chinese, at the time
of departure producing a pistol, and telling the chief-
tenant that they were going to the police station, but
did not mention which station. The chief-tenant did not
therefore, report to the station, as she believed that
these men were detectives.

Enquiries were made at the Public Safety Bureau H.Q.
in an effort to ascertain whether or not detectives from
there, or Chiangkiang detectives had arrested the occupants
of the above room, but the undersigned was informed that
nothing could be done until 9a.m. on Monday, 12/8/35, at
which time the chief-tenant could see "Yan Siau Err Tu"
arrested in Chapel, for the purpose of identification, as
to whether he was really the tenant of the room in question
The room had the appearance of having been searched, one
box lying open upon the bed, with the contents strewn
about, and several small drawers of a clothes closet were
open.

The chief-tenant has been warned to keep the room lock
ed up for the time being, pending further instructions. The
room was engaged about 3 months ago by the man known as
"Jing", whose only business appeared to be that of a money
lender, according to the chief-tenant, "Jing" and his wife
never appeared to leave the house.
pages.zh:
O.O.L.19/35.

1 (2)

并将他们带走，其中一名华籍男子在离开时出示了一支手枪，并告诉二房东他们要去警察局，但未说明是哪个警察局。因此，二房东没有向本警局报告，因为她相信这些人是侦探。

随后向公共安全局总部进行了查询，以查明是否是该局的侦探或江苏侦探逮捕了上述房间的住客，但签署人被告知，在1935年8月12日（星期一）上午9时之前无法采取任何行动，届时二房东可以在拘留所见到被捕的“严小二秃”（Yan Siau Err Tu，音译），以便辨认他是否确实是涉事房间的租客。
该房间呈现出被搜查过的迹象，一个箱子敞开放在床上，里面的物品散落一地，衣柜的几个小抽屉也是开着的。

已警告二房东暂时将房间锁好，等待进一步指示。据二房东称，该房间于约3个月前由一名被称为“金”（Jing，音译）的男子租用，他唯一的职业似乎是放贷人，“金”及其妻子似乎从未离开过住所。

1 (3)

There is a possibility that these two persons have
been implicated by "Tan Siau Err Tu", and were therefore
arrested by the Chinkiang detectives without reporting
to the Station. An attempt will be made to see "Tan Siau
Err Tu" a.m. 12/6/35, at which time, the chief-tenant,
